goal: Provide proactive Orbit Agent email-like messages for calendar activities that start in one hour.

success_criteria.description: A proactive agent service detects local schedule or event entries starting within one hour and creates an email-like in-app message with the event title, time, people context, and preparation prompt.
Clicking the proactive message opens a new Orbit AI conversation whose context is the triggering calendar activity and whose first generated response uses that context.
Tests prove the trigger is idempotent for the same activity window and does not send an external email, push notification, SMS, or calendar update.
GET /app/chat or /app/agent surfaces the proactive message in a localized inbox-style UI with a link to the context conversation.
The feature documentation defines timing windows, local delivery semantics, future live notification boundaries, and privacy constraints.

out_of_scope: Real background jobs, push notifications, email sends, SMS sends, or remote scheduler writes
